"""Fused MoE (MXFP4 weights, fp8 activations, interleaved gate/up, clamped SiLU, expert mask): routing, then
aiter's FlyDSL stage-1 and stage-2 GEMMs edited per shape. Small batches fold the routing into stage 1 (two
launches); the largest runs a separate prelude that sorts, quantizes and warms W1 (three)."""

import functools
import hashlib
import inspect
import types

import flydsl.compiler as flyc
import flydsl.expr as fx
import torch
from aiter import dtypes
from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops, vector
from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import mixed_moe_gemm_2stage_common as _mm_common
from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels.moe_sorting_kernel import (
    _allwave_inclusive_prefix_sum,
    _dpp_intra_wave_prefix_sum,
    _lds_load_raw,
    _lds_store_raw,
)
from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels.moe_sorting_kernel import _unwrap_val as _raw
from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels.tensor_shim import ptr_arg
from aiter.ops.flydsl.moe_common import GateMode
from aiter.ops.flydsl.moe_kernels import _flydsl_moe_stage1_impl, _flydsl_moe_stage2_impl, _s1_args_fp4
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import arith as _marith
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import llvm
from flydsl.expr import arith, const_expr, gpu, range_constexpr, rocdl
from flydsl.expr.typing import T

_TILE_M = 32
_TILE_K = 256
_S1_TILE_N = 128
_S1_GX = 2 * 2048 // _S1_TILE_N  # stage-1 n-blocks (interleaved gate/up rows)

BLOCK = 256
WAVE = 64
NUM_WAVES = BLOCK // WAVE
UNIT = 32
N_LOCAL = 32
_WARM_WGS = 256  # warm-only workgroups appended to the prelude grid
_AMAX_FLOOR = 0x2EDBE6FF  # f32 bits of 1e-10, the reference's initial group max


def _popc(v):
    return fx.Int32(fx.math.ctpop(v))


def _e8m0(amax):
    """fp8 e8m0 scale exponent (rounded up) of a group whose max |x| has the f32 bits ``amax``. aiter's
    emit_mx_e8m0_scale adds a clamp; part2 inlines this sequence, which measured slower through a helper."""
    qb = fx.Int32(
        arith.bitcast(T.i32, _raw(arith.bitcast(T.f32, _raw(amax)) * arith.constant(1.0 / 448.0, type=T.f32)))
    )
    ex = (qb >> fx.Int32(23)) & fx.Int32(0xFF)
    bump = (ex < fx.Int32(0xFF)) & ((qb & fx.Int32(0x7FFFFF)) != fx.Int32(0))
    return bump.select(ex + fx.Int32(1), ex)


def _ballot(pred):
    """The wave's 64-bit ballot of ``pred`` as its low and high 32-bit halves."""
    b = rocdl.ballot(T.i64, _raw(pred))
    return fx.Int32(arith.trunci(T.i32, b)), fx.Int32(
        arith.trunci(T.i32, arith.shrui(b, arith.constant(32, type=T.i64)))
    )


def _below(r):
    """Low and high halves of the 64-bit mask of the bits below bit ``r``."""
    c1 = fx.Int32(1)
    rm = (c1 << (r & fx.Int32(31))) - c1
    return (r >= fx.Int32(32)).select(fx.Int32(-1), rm), (r >= fx.Int32(32)).select(rm, fx.Int32(0))


def _mask_lids(mask_rsrc, tid):
    """The mask values of global experts lane + 64 j, j < 4 (the four loads every lane issues)."""
    lane = tid % fx.Int32(WAVE)
    return [
        buffer_ops.buffer_load(mask_rsrc, lane + fx.Int32(WAVE * j), vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32)
        for j in range_constexpr(NUM_WAVES)
    ]


def _local_id(mvals, tid):
    """Local id of global expert tid (-1 if masked out): four ballots give every wave the whole mask, so the
    exclusive prefix is popcounts, with no LDS round trip or barrier."""
    lane = tid % fx.Int32(WAVE)
    wave = tid // fx.Int32(WAVE)
    c0 = fx.Int32(0)
    c1 = fx.Int32(1)
    mlo, mhi = _below(lane)
    before = c0
    rank = c0
    mine = c0
    for j in range_constexpr(NUM_WAVES):
        on = fx.Int32(mvals[j]) != c0
        blo, bhi = _ballot(on)
        before = (wave > fx.Int32(j)).select(before + _popc(blo) + _popc(bhi), before)
        isw = wave == fx.Int32(j)
        rank = isw.select(_popc(blo & mlo) + _popc(bhi & mhi), rank)
        mine = isw.select(on.select(c1, c0), mine)
    return (mine != c0).select(before + rank, fx.Int32(-1))


@functools.cache
def compile_prelude(n_tokens: int, topk: int, global_experts: int, model_dim: int, warm_s: int):
    assert n_tokens <= BLOCK and global_experts == BLOCK and model_dim == BLOCK * 16
    N = n_tokens
    assert N % 8 == 0  # warm workgroup w then sits on XCD w mod 8
    WARM_TILES = N_LOCAL * _S1_GX // _WARM_WGS  # (expert, n-block) tiles per warm workgroup
    W1_KTILE_BYTES = _TILE_K // 2 * 16  # one fp4 k-tile of a 16-row preshuffled block
    W1_NBLK_BYTES = 16 * model_dim // 2
    W1_EXPERT_BYTES = _S1_GX * _S1_TILE_N * model_dim // 2
    # 16-byte pieces warmed per tile: half the k-tile of each 16-row block
    WARM_PIECES = (_S1_TILE_N // 16) * W1_KTILE_BYTES // 2 // 16
    assert (N + UNIT - 1) // UNIT <= 8  # 8 threads per expert write its block ids
    scale_cols = model_dim // 32
    row_scale_bytes = UNIT * scale_cols  # one 32-row block of sorted scales

    @fx.struct
    class SharedStorage:
        lmap: fx.Array[fx.Int32, BLOCK, 16]
        bm: fx.Array[fx.Int32, NUM_WAVES * N_LOCAL * 2, 16]
        tbl: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 5 * N_LOCAL, 16]
        pos: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 8, 16]
        scratch: fx.Array[fx.Int32, NUM_WAVES, 16]

    @flyc.kernel(known_block_size=[BLOCK, 1, 1])
    def moe_prelude_kernel(
        topk_ids: fx.Tensor,
        topk_weights: fx.Tensor,
        expert_mask: fx.Tensor,
        x: fx.Tensor,
        sorted_ids: fx.Tensor,
        sorted_weights: fx.Tensor,
        sorted_expert_ids: fx.Tensor,
        num_valid_ids: fx.Tensor,
        a1: fx.Tensor,
        a1_scale: fx.Tensor,
        w1: fx.Tensor,
    ):
        bid_raw = gpu.block_idx.x
        tid = gpu.thread_idx.x
        lane = tid % WAVE
        wave = tid // WAVE
        c0 = fx.Int32(0)
        c1 = fx.Int32(1)

        if bid_raw >= fx.Int32(N):
            # Warm-only workgroups request the start k-tile of every (local expert, n-block) of W1 from the
            # XCD that stage 1 runs that n-block on, so stage 1's first loads hit cache.
            w1_rsrc = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource(w1, max_size=True)
            sink_rsrc = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource(num_valid_ids, max_size=False, num_records_bytes=8)
            wid = bid_raw - fx.Int32(N)
            xcd = wid & fx.Int32(7)
            j = wid >> fx.Int32(3)
            acc = []
            for i in range_constexpr(WARM_TILES):
                t = j * fx.Int32(WARM_TILES) + fx.Int32(i)
                e = t >> fx.Int32(2)
                nb = xcd + (t & fx.Int32(3)) * fx.Int32(8)
                kt = (e * fx.Int32(warm_s)) & fx.Int32(model_dim // _TILE_K - 1)
                base = (
                    e * fx.Int32(W1_EXPERT_BYTES)
                    + nb * fx.Int32(8 * W1_NBLK_BYTES)
                    + kt * fx.Int32(W1_KTILE_BYTES)
                )
                for q in range_constexpr(WARM_PIECES // BLOCK):
                    piece = tid + fx.Int32(BLOCK * q)
                    off = (
                        base
                        + (piece // fx.Int32(WARM_PIECES // 8)) * fx.Int32(W1_NBLK_BYTES)
                        + (piece % fx.Int32(WARM_PIECES // 8)) * fx.Int32(16)
                    )
                    acc.append(buffer_ops.buffer_load(w1_rsrc, off >> fx.Int32(2), vec_width=4, dtype=T.i32))
            v = c0
            for a in acc:
                for q in range_constexpr(4):
                    v = v ^ fx.Int32(vector.extract(a, static_position=[q], dynamic_position=[]))
            # out of the sink's range, so the store is dropped; it only keeps the loads alive
            buffer_ops.buffer_store(v, sink_rsrc, fx.Int32(64), offset_is_bytes=True)
        else:
            bid = bid_raw
            ids_rsrc = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource(topk_ids, max_size=True)
            w_rsrc = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource(topk_weights, max_size=True)
            mask_rsrc = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource(expert_mask, max_size=True)
            x_rsrc = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource(x, max_size=True)
            sid_rsrc = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource(sorted_ids, max_size=True)
            sw_rsrc = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource(sorted_weights, max_size=True)
            se_rsrc = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource(sorted_expert_ids, max_size=True)
            nv_rsrc = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource(num_valid_ids, max_size=True)
            a1_rsrc = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource(a1, max_size=True)
            sc_rsrc = buffer_ops.create_buffer_resource(a1_scale, max_size=True)

            lds = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(SharedStorage).peek()
            lmap_mr = lds.lmap.ptr
            bm_mr = lds.bm.ptr
            tbl_mr = lds.tbl.ptr
            pos_mr = lds.pos.ptr
            scratch_mr = lds.scratch.ptr

            mval = buffer_ops.buffer_load(mask_rsrc, tid, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32)
            tok_valid = tid < fx.Int32(N)
            safe_tok = tok_valid.select(tid, c0)
            gids = []
            for j in range_constexpr(topk // 2):
                v = buffer_ops.buffer_load(
                    ids_rsrc, safe_tok * fx.Int32(topk) + fx.Int32(2 * j), vec_width=2, dtype=T.i32
                )
                gids.append(fx.Int32(vector.extract(v, static_position=[0], dynamic_position=[])))
                gids.append(fx.Int32(vector.extract(v, static_position=[1], dynamic_position=[])))
            kk = lane & fx.Int32(7)
            kk_safe = (kk < fx.Int32(topk)).select(kk, c0)
            my_g = buffer_ops.buffer_load(ids_rsrc, bid * fx.Int32(topk) + kk_safe, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32)
            my_w = buffer_ops.buffer_load(w_rsrc, bid * fx.Int32(topk) + kk_safe, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32)
            xoff = bid * fx.Int32(model_dim // 2) + tid * fx.Int32(8)
            xv0 = buffer_ops.buffer_load(x_rsrc, xoff, vec_width=4, dtype=T.i32)
            xv1 = buffer_ops.buffer_load(x_rsrc, xoff + fx.Int32(4), vec_width=4, dtype=T.i32)

            mbit = (mval != c0).select(c1, c0)
            _, incl = _allwave_inclusive_prefix_sum(mbit, lane, wave, scratch_mr, NUM_WAVES, WAVE)
            _lds_store_raw(lmap_mr, (mbit != c0).select(incl - c1, fx.Int32(-1)), tid)

            # Quantize row bid (two threads per scale group) while the sort runs; the scale bytes are
            # scattered once the sorted rows are known.
            words = []
            for i in range_constexpr(4):
                words.append(fx.Int32(vector.extract(xv0, static_position=[i], dynamic_position=[])))
            for i in range_constexpr(4):
                words.append(fx.Int32(vector.extract(xv1, static_position=[i], dynamic_position=[])))
            vals = []
            amax = fx.Int32(_AMAX_FLOOR)
            for i in range_constexpr(8):
                lo = words[i] << fx.Int32(16)
                hi = words[i] & fx.Int32(-65536)
                vals.append(lo)
                vals.append(hi)
                alo = lo & fx.Int32(0x7FFFFFFF)
                ahi = hi & fx.Int32(0x7FFFFFFF)
                amax = (alo > amax).select(alo, amax)
                amax = (ahi > amax).select(ahi, amax)
            peer = fx.Int32(amax.shuffle_xor(c1, fx.Int32(WAVE)))
            amax = (peer > amax).select(peer, amax)
            ex = _e8m0(amax)
            inv = arith.bitcast(T.f32, _raw((fx.Int32(254) - ex) << fx.Int32(23)))
            packed = []
            for wq in range_constexpr(4):
                pw = c0
                for h in range_constexpr(2):
                    fa = arith.bitcast(T.f32, _raw(vals[wq * 4 + 2 * h])) * inv
                    fb = arith.bitcast(T.f32, _raw(vals[wq * 4 + 2 * h + 1])) * inv
                    pw = rocdl.cvt_pk_fp8_f32(T.i32, _raw(fa), _raw(fb), _raw(pw), h)
                packed.append(_raw(pw))
            qvec = vector.from_elements(T.vec(4, T.i32), packed)
            buffer_ops.buffer_store(qvec, a1_rsrc, bid * fx.Int32(model_dim // 4) + tid * fx.Int32(4))
            gpu.barrier()

            tmask = c0
            for k in range_constexpr(topk):
                e = _lds_load_raw(lmap_mr, gids[k])
                tmask = tmask | (e >= c0).select(c1 << (e & fx.Int32(31)), c0)
            tmask = tok_valid.select(tmask, c0)

            # lane e of each wave keeps the set of the wave's tokens that route to local expert e
            my_lo = c0
            my_hi = c0
            for e in range_constexpr(N_LOCAL):
                bit = (tmask >> fx.Int32(e)) & c1
                blo, bhi = _ballot(bit != c0)
                is_e = lane == fx.Int32(e)
                my_lo = is_e.select(blo, my_lo)
                my_hi = is_e.select(bhi, my_hi)
            if lane < fx.Int32(N_LOCAL):
                _lds_store_raw(bm_mr, my_lo, (wave * fx.Int32(N_LOCAL) + lane) * fx.Int32(2))
                _lds_store_raw(bm_mr, my_hi, (wave * fx.Int32(N_LOCAL) + lane) * fx.Int32(2) + c1)
            gpu.barrier()

            if wave == c0:
                e_valid = lane < fx.Int32(N_LOCAL)
                e_safe = e_valid.select(lane, c0)
                wb = bid >> fx.Int32(6)
                total = c0
                before = c0
                for w in range_constexpr(NUM_WAVES):
                    lo = _lds_load_raw(bm_mr, (fx.Int32(w * N_LOCAL) + e_safe) * fx.Int32(2))
                    hi = _lds_load_raw(bm_mr, (fx.Int32(w * N_LOCAL) + e_safe) * fx.Int32(2) + c1)
                    cw = _popc(lo) + _popc(hi)
                    total = total + cw
                    before = (wb > fx.Int32(w)).select(before + cw, before)
                total = e_valid.select(total, c0)
                nblk = (total + fx.Int32(UNIT - 1)) // fx.Int32(UNIT)
                blk_incl = _dpp_intra_wave_prefix_sum(nblk, lane, WAVE)
                blk_excl = blk_incl - nblk
                row0 = blk_excl * fx.Int32(UNIT)
                if e_valid:
                    _lds_store_raw(tbl_mr, row0, lane)
                    _lds_store_raw(tbl_mr, total, lane + fx.Int32(N_LOCAL))
                    _lds_store_raw(tbl_mr, nblk, lane + fx.Int32(2 * N_LOCAL))
                    _lds_store_raw(tbl_mr, blk_excl, lane + fx.Int32(3 * N_LOCAL))
                    _lds_store_raw(tbl_mr, row0 + before, lane + fx.Int32(4 * N_LOCAL))
                if lane < fx.Int32(topk):
                    ek = _lds_load_raw(lmap_mr, my_g)
                    has = ek >= c0
                    ek_s = ek & fx.Int32(N_LOCAL - 1)
                    r = bid & fx.Int32(63)
                    mlo, mhi = _below(r)
                    blo = _lds_load_raw(bm_mr, (wb * fx.Int32(N_LOCAL) + ek_s) * fx.Int32(2))
                    bhi = _lds_load_raw(bm_mr, (wb * fx.Int32(N_LOCAL) + ek_s) * fx.Int32(2) + c1)
                    bse = _lds_load_raw(tbl_mr, ek_s + fx.Int32(4 * N_LOCAL))
                    p = has.select(bse + _popc(blo & mlo) + _popc(bhi & mhi), fx.Int32(-1))
                    _lds_store_raw(pos_mr, p, lane)
                    if has:
                        buffer_ops.buffer_store((lane << fx.Int32(24)) | bid, sid_rsrc, p)
                        buffer_ops.buffer_store(my_w, sw_rsrc, p)
            gpu.barrier()

            if bid == c0:
                pe = tid >> fx.Int32(3)
                ps = tid & fx.Int32(7)
                prow0 = _lds_load_raw(tbl_mr, pe)
                ptot = _lds_load_raw(tbl_mr, pe + fx.Int32(N_LOCAL))
                pnblk = _lds_load_raw(tbl_mr, pe + fx.Int32(2 * N_LOCAL))
                pbex = _lds_load_raw(tbl_mr, pe + fx.Int32(3 * N_LOCAL))
                pend = (pbex + pnblk) * fx.Int32(UNIT)
                sentinel = fx.Int32((topk << 24) | N)
                for jj in range_constexpr(4):
                    j = ps + fx.Int32(8 * jj)
                    pr = prow0 + ptot + j
                    if (j < fx.Int32(UNIT - 1)) & (pr < pend):
                        buffer_ops.buffer_store(sentinel, sid_rsrc, pr)
                        buffer_ops.buffer_store(c0, sw_rsrc, pr)
                if ps < pnblk:
                    buffer_ops.buffer_store(pe, se_rsrc, pbex + ps)
                if tid == fx.Int32(BLOCK - 1):
                    buffer_ops.buffer_store(pend, nv_rsrc, c0)
                    buffer_ops.buffer_store(fx.Int32(N), nv_rsrc, c1)

            y = tid >> c1
            ycol = (
                (y >> fx.Int32(3)) * fx.Int32(256)
                + (y & fx.Int32(3)) * fx.Int32(64)
                + ((y >> fx.Int32(2)) & c1) * fx.Int32(2)
            )
            sbyte = arith.trunci(T.i8, _raw(ex))
            if (tid & c1) == c0:
                for k in range_constexpr(topk):
                    p = _lds_load_raw(pos_mr, fx.Int32(k))
                    if p >= c0:
                        off = (
                            (p >> fx.Int32(5)) * fx.Int32(row_scale_bytes)
                            + ycol
                            + (p & fx.Int32(15)) * fx.Int32(4)
                            + ((p >> fx.Int32(4)) & c1)
                        )
                        buffer_ops.buffer_store(sbyte, sc_rsrc, off, offset_is_bytes=True)

    @flyc.jit
    def launch(
        topk_ids: fx.Tensor,
        topk_weights: fx.Tensor,
        expert_mask: fx.Tensor,
        x: fx.Tensor,
        sorted_ids: fx.Tensor,
        sorted_weights: fx.Tensor,
        sorted_expert_ids: fx.Tensor,
        num_valid_ids: fx.Tensor,
        a1: fx.Tensor,
        a1_scale: fx.Tensor,
        w1: fx.Tensor,
        stream: fx.Stream = None,
    ):
        stream = stream if stream is not None else fx.Stream(None)
        moe_prelude_kernel(
            topk_ids,
            topk_weights,
            expert_mask,
            x,
            sorted_ids,
            sorted_weights,
            sorted_expert_ids,
            num_valid_ids,
            a1,
            a1_scale,
            w1,
        ).launch(grid=(N + _WARM_WGS, 1, 1), block=(BLOCK, 1, 1), stream=stream)

    return launch


# Both GEMMs are aiter's FlyDSL builders edited by exact source replacement. Each m-block starts its K loop at
# its own rotated k-tile and wraps, so experts streaming at once (every one starting on an aligned expert
# boundary) do not hit the same address bits together; the accumulation order stays fixed per m-block.
_TIERS = (  # by n * topk: persist_m, rotations (stage 1, stage-2 m, n), fold, s2 tile_n, waves, qphase
    (96, (1, 2, 2, 1, True, 64, 4, None)),
    (192, (1, 9, 3, 0, True, 128, 3, -1)),
    (767, (1, 9, 3, 0, True, 128, 3, 1)),
    (1535, (2, 3, 3, 1, True, 128, 3, -1)),
    (1 << 30, (1, 3, 3, 1, False, 128, 3, None)),
)


def _s1_edits(s):
    kmod = " % arith.constant(k_dim, index=True)"
    return (
        (
            "                body_k_base_idx = k_base_idx\n",
            "                body_k_base_idx = ((expert_idx * arith.constant(%d, index=True))"
            " %% arith.constant(k_dim // tile_k, index=True)) * arith.constant(tile_k, index=True)\n" % s,
        ),
        (
            "abs_k = body_k_base_idx + arith.constant(next_k_load, index=True)\n",
            "abs_k = (body_k_base_idx + arith.constant(next_k_load, index=True))" + kmod + "\n",
        ),
        (
            "abs_k_dma = body_k_base_idx + arith.constant(\n"
            "                        next_k_dma_py, index=True\n"
            "                    )\n",
            "abs_k_dma = (body_k_base_idx + arith.constant(next_k_dma_py, index=True))" + kmod + "\n",
        ),
        (
            "k1 = body_k_base_idx + arith.constant(tile_k, index=True)\n",
            "k1 = (body_k_base_idx + arith.constant(tile_k, index=True))" + kmod + "\n",
        ),
        (
            "k_tail1 = body_k_base_idx + k_tail_rel\n",
            "k_tail1 = (body_k_base_idx + k_tail_rel)" + kmod + "\n",
        ),
    )


_S1_TID_BLOCK = (
    "                c_tile_m_idx = arith.constant(tile_m, index=True)\n"
    "                tid_in_range = arith.cmpi(CmpIPredicate.ult, tx, c_tile_m_idx)\n"
    "                if_tid = scf.IfOp(tid_in_range)\n"
    "                with ir.InsertionPoint(if_tid.then_block):\n"
    "                    tid_row = bx_m + tx\n"
    "                    tid_val = buffer_ops.buffer_load(\n"
    "                        sorted_rsrc, tid_row, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32\n"
    "                    )\n"
    "                    tid_vec1 = vector.from_elements(T.vec(1, T.i32), [tid_val])\n"
    "                    vector.store(tid_vec1, lds_tid, [tx])\n"
    "                    scf.YieldOp([])\n"
)


def _s1_hoist_edits():
    """Stage-1 head order when unfolded: W1's first k-tile and the k0 scales are requested before the k0 A copy,
    the token-id load and its LDS store after the k1 copy, so no wait separates the head's loads."""
    return (
        (
            "                k0_scale = body_k_base_idx // arith.constant(pack_K * 128, index=True)\n"
            "                a_scale_pong, gate_bs_pong, up_bs_pong = prefetch_ab_scale_tile(\n"
            "                    k0_scale\n"
            "                )\n" + _S1_TID_BLOCK,
            "",
        ),
        (
            "                k0_b = body_k_base_idx // arith.constant(b_byte_div, index=True)\n"
            "                gate_w0, up_w0 = load_b_tile(k0_b)\n",
            _S1_TID_BLOCK,
        ),
        (
            "                k0 = body_k_base_idx\n"
            "                if const_expr(use_async_copy):\n"
            "                    prefetch_x_to_lds(k0, body_lds_x_pong)\n",
            "                k0_b = body_k_base_idx // arith.constant(b_byte_div, index=True)\n"
            "                gate_w0, up_w0 = load_b_tile(k0_b)\n"
            "                k0_scale = body_k_base_idx // arith.constant(pack_K * 128, index=True)\n"
            "                a_scale_pong, gate_bs_pong, up_bs_pong = prefetch_ab_scale_tile(\n"
            "                    k0_scale\n"
            "                )\n"
            "                k0 = body_k_base_idx\n"
            "                if const_expr(use_async_copy):\n"
            "                    prefetch_x_to_lds(k0, body_lds_x_pong)\n",
        ),
    )


# Padding rows of a block gather from row ``tokens``, past the end of the activation buffer, so their A loads
# return zeros without touching memory instead of re-reading token 0. Their outputs are discarded per row
# either way.
_S1_PAD_CLAMP = (
    "t_safe = arith.select(ts_valid, t_i32, arith.constant(0))\n",
    "t_safe = arith.select(ts_valid, t_i32, tokens_i32)\n",
)


# Stage-2 head: the block's expert id and first sorted id are requested before num_valid_ids is read back (it
# sizes the A-scale resource), so the three small loads overlap instead of running one after another.
_S2_LATE_NUM_VALID = (
    (
        "            num_valid_i32 = rocdl.ReadfirstlaneOp(T.i32, num_valid_i32).res\n"
        "            num_valid_idx = arith.index_cast(ir.IndexType.get(), num_valid_i32)\n"
        "\n"
        "            if const_expr(is_f4_a or is_f8_a):\n",
        "            num_valid_raw = num_valid_i32\n"
        "\n"
        "            def _late_num_valid():\n"
        "              num_valid_i32 = rocdl.ReadfirstlaneOp(T.i32, num_valid_raw).res\n"
        "              num_valid_idx = arith.index_cast(ir.IndexType.get(), num_valid_i32)\n"
        "              if const_expr(is_f4_a or is_f8_a):\n",
    ),
    (
        "                sx_nbytes_i32 = arith.index_cast(T.i32, sx_nbytes_idx)\n"
        "                sx_rsrc = ptr_buffer_resource(arg_scale_x, sx_nbytes_i32)\n"
        "            else:\n"
        "                sx_nbytes_idx = (tokens_in * c_topk) * arith.constant(4, index=True)\n"
        "                sx_nbytes_i32 = arith.index_cast(T.i32, sx_nbytes_idx)\n"
        "                sx_rsrc = ptr_buffer_resource(arg_scale_x, sx_nbytes_i32)\n"
        "\n",
        "                sx_nbytes_i32 = arith.index_cast(T.i32, sx_nbytes_idx)\n"
        "                sx_rsrc = ptr_buffer_resource(arg_scale_x, sx_nbytes_i32)\n"
        "              else:\n"
        "                sx_nbytes_idx = (tokens_in * c_topk) * arith.constant(4, index=True)\n"
        "                sx_nbytes_i32 = arith.index_cast(T.i32, sx_nbytes_idx)\n"
        "                sx_rsrc = ptr_buffer_resource(arg_scale_x, sx_nbytes_i32)\n"
        "              return num_valid_i32, num_valid_idx, sx_rsrc\n"
        "\n",
    ),
    (
        "            bx_m_i32 = arith.index_cast(T.i32, bx_m)\n"
        "            blk_valid = arith.cmpi(CmpIPredicate.ult, bx_m_i32, num_valid_i32)\n",
        "            bx_m_i32 = arith.index_cast(T.i32, bx_m)\n",
    ),
    (
        "            first_tok = buffer_ops.buffer_load(\n"
        "                sorted_rsrc, bx_m, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32\n"
        "            )\n",
        "            first_tok = buffer_ops.buffer_load(\n"
        "                sorted_rsrc, bx_m, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32\n"
        "            )\n"
        "            num_valid_i32, num_valid_idx, sx_rsrc = _late_num_valid()\n"
        "            blk_valid = arith.cmpi(CmpIPredicate.ult, bx_m_i32, num_valid_i32)\n",
    ),
)


def _s2_edits(s, r=0):
    nterm = " + by * arith.constant(%d, index=True)" % r if r else ""
    kmod = " % arith.constant(int(inter_dim), index=True)"
    return (
        (
            "                def k_base(k_py):\n                    return k_py // scale_pack_k // 128\n",
            "                def k_base(k_py):\n"
            "                    return ((kf_start + arith.constant(k_py, index=True))"
            + kmod
            + ") // arith.constant(\n"
            "                        scale_pack_k * 128, index=True\n"
            "                    )\n",
        ),
        (
            "                k0 = arith.index(0)\n                k0_bk = k0\n",
            "                kf_start = ((bx * arith.constant(%d, index=True)%s)"
            " %% arith.constant(int(inter_dim) // tile_k, index=True)) * arith.constant(tile_k, index=True)\n"
            "                k0 = kf_start\n"
            "                k0_bk = k0 // b_byte_div\n" % (s, nterm),
        ),
        ("next_k1 = k_iv + tile_k\n", "next_k1 = (kf_start + k_iv + tile_k)" + kmod + "\n"),
        ("next_k2 = k_iv + c2_tile_k\n", "next_k2 = (kf_start + k_iv + c2_tile_k)" + kmod + "\n"),
        (
            "k_tail1 = (k_in + tile_k - 1) // tile_k * tile_k - tile_k\n",
            "k_tail1 = (kf_start + (k_in + tile_k - 1) // tile_k * tile_k - tile_k)" + kmod + "\n",
        ),
    )


# Folded routing: every stage-1 workgroup re-runs the routing in LDS for its own m-block(s), zeroes a stripe
# of ``out`` and publishes what stage 2 reads, so no workgroup waits for another. A loads come from a1 written
# by part2 (smallest tier) or from x, quantized in stage 1's A loader (_iq_edits).
_FOLD_EXTRA = ("arg_f_ids", "arg_f_w", "arg_f_mask", "arg_f_x", "arg_f_out", "arg_f_sw")


@functools.cache
def _make_fold_head(N, topk, gx, gy, model_dim, early_w1, pm):
    assert N <= BLOCK and model_dim == BLOCK * 16
    G = gx * gy
    n_chunks = N * model_dim * 2 // (BLOCK * 16)  # 4 KiB pieces of out, one 16-byte store per thread
    z_iters = (n_chunks + G - 1) // G
    row_scale_bytes = UNIT * (model_dim // 32)
    row_words = model_dim // 2  # bf16 row in i32 words
    sentinel = (topk << 24) | N
    x_lines = N * model_dim * 2 // 64
    touch_per_wg = min(BLOCK, -(-x_lines // max(1, G // 8)))
    W1_LOADS = 5  # vector loads per thread of the early W1 request: load_b_tile's four, one of W1 scales

    @fx.struct
    class FoldLds:
        lmap: fx.Array[fx.Int32, BLOCK, 16]
        cnt: fx.Array[fx.Int32, NUM_WAVES * N_LOCAL, 16]
        rows: fx.Array[fx.Int32, UNIT * pm, 16]
        rw: fx.Array[fx.Int32, UNIT * pm, 16]
        info: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 8 * pm, 16]
        asc: fx.Array[fx.Int32, 2 * WAVE, 16]

    def alloc():
        lds = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(FoldLds).peek()
        return lds.lmap.ptr, lds.cnt.ptr, lds.rows.ptr, lds.rw.ptr, lds.info.ptr, lds.asc.ptr

    @flyc.jit
    def part1s(
        ids_rsrc,
        w_rsrc,
        mask_rsrc,
        out_rsrc,
        sid_rsrc,
        sw_rsrc,
        se_rsrc,
        nv_rsrc,
        x_rsrc,
        lmap_mr,
        cnt_mr,
        rows_mr,
        rw_mr,
        info_mr,
        c_i32,
        nb_i32,
    ):
        """Routing head when every expert fits one block: wave 0 holds every token, and block c is the c-th
        expert any token hits, its rows ranked by one ballot."""
        tid = fx.Int32(arith.index_cast(T.i32, _raw(gpu.thread_idx.x)))
        lane = tid % fx.Int32(WAVE)
        wave = tid // fx.Int32(WAVE)
        c = fx.Int32(c_i32)
        nb = fx.Int32(nb_i32)
        c0 = fx.Int32(0)
        c1 = fx.Int32(1)

        mvals = _mask_lids(mask_rsrc, tid)
        tok_valid = tid < fx.Int32(N)
        safe_tok = tok_valid.select(tid, c0)
        gids = []
        wts = []
        for jx in range_constexpr(topk // 2):
            v = buffer_ops.buffer_load(
                ids_rsrc, safe_tok * fx.Int32(topk) + fx.Int32(2 * jx), vec_width=2, dtype=T.i32
            )
            gids.append(fx.Int32(vector.extract(v, static_position=[0], dynamic_position=[])))
            gids.append(fx.Int32(vector.extract(v, static_position=[1], dynamic_position=[])))
        for jx in range_constexpr(topk // 2):
            v = buffer_ops.buffer_load(
                w_rsrc, safe_tok * fx.Int32(topk) + fx.Int32(2 * jx), vec_width=2, dtype=T.i32
            )
            wts.append(fx.Int32(vector.extract(v, static_position=[0], dynamic_position=[])))
            wts.append(fx.Int32(vector.extract(v, static_position=[1], dynamic_position=[])))

        flat = c * fx.Int32(gx) + nb
        # Touch every 64-byte piece of x under both workgroup-to-XCD mappings, so the A loads hit cache.
        t_line = (flat >> fx.Int32(3)) * fx.Int32(touch_per_wg) + tid
        t_ok = (tid < fx.Int32(touch_per_wg)) & (t_line < fx.Int32(x_lines))
        touch = buffer_ops.buffer_load(
            x_rsrc, t_ok.select(t_line, c0) * fx.Int32(16), vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32
        )
        t_line2 = (flat % fx.Int32(max(1, G // 8))) * fx.Int32(touch_per_wg) + tid
        t_ok2 = (tid < fx.Int32(touch_per_wg)) & (t_line2 < fx.Int32(x_lines))
        touch2 = buffer_ops.buffer_load(
            x_rsrc, t_ok2.select(t_line2, c0) * fx.Int32(16), vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32
        )
        if const_expr(not early_w1):
            touch = touch + touch2
            touch2 = c0
        zeros = fx.Vector.filled(4, 0, fx.Int32)
        for i in range_constexpr(z_iters):
            ch = fx.Int32(G - 1) - flat + fx.Int32(i * G)
            if ch < fx.Int32(n_chunks):
                buffer_ops.buffer_store(zeros, out_rsrc, ch * fx.Int32(BLOCK * 4) + tid * fx.Int32(4))

        if tid < fx.Int32(UNIT):
            _lds_store_raw(rows_mr, fx.Int32(sentinel), tid)
            _lds_store_raw(rw_mr, c0, tid)

        _lds_store_raw(lmap_mr, _local_id(mvals, tid), tid)
        gpu.barrier()
        if const_expr(early_w1):
            # Retire the routing loads in every wave, leaving the two x touches, so no register reuse waits on
            # part2's stores for them.
            rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=2)

        if wave == c0:
            les = []
            tmask = c0
            for k in range_constexpr(topk):
                e = _lds_load_raw(lmap_mr, gids[k])
                les.append(e)
                tmask = tmask | (e >= c0).select(c1 << (e & fx.Int32(31)), c0)
            tmask = tok_valid.select(tmask, c0)
            hm = tmask
            for sh in range_constexpr(6):
                hm = hm | fx.Int32(hm.shuffle_xor(fx.Int32(1 << sh), fx.Int32(WAVE)))
            nhit = _popc(hm)
            l32 = lane & fx.Int32(31)
            selb = (lane < fx.Int32(32)) & (((hm >> l32) & c1) != c0) & (_popc(hm & ((c1 << l32) - c1)) == c)
            sel = fx.Int32(arith.trunci(T.i32, rocdl.ballot(T.i64, _raw(selb))))
            ec = (c < nhit).select(_popc((sel & (c0 - sel)) - c1), fx.Int32(-1))
            if lane == c0:
                _lds_store_raw(info_mr, ec, c0)
                _lds_store_raw(info_mr, nhit * fx.Int32(UNIT), fx.Int32(3))
            slot = c0
            wsel = c0
            hit = fx.Int32(0) != c0
            for k in range_constexpr(topk):
                mk = les[k] == ec
                slot = mk.select(fx.Int32(k), slot)
                wsel = mk.select(wts[k], wsel)
                hit = hit | mk
            hit = hit & tok_valid & (ec >= c0)
            blo, bhi = _ballot(hit)
            mlo, mhi = _below(lane)
            rank = _popc(blo & mlo) + _popc(bhi & mhi)
            if lane == c0:
                _lds_store_raw(info_mr, _popc(blo) + _popc(bhi), fx.Int32(2))
            if hit:
                _lds_store_raw(rows_mr, (slot << fx.Int32(24)) | tid, rank)
                _lds_store_raw(rw_mr, wsel, rank)
        gpu.barrier()
        ec = _lds_load_raw(info_mr, c0)
        etot = _lds_load_raw(info_mr, fx.Int32(2))
        pend = _lds_load_raw(info_mr, fx.Int32(3))

        blk_ok = ec >= c0
        if (nb == c0) & (tid < fx.Int32(UNIT)):
            buffer_ops.buffer_store(_lds_load_raw(rows_mr, tid), sid_rsrc, c * fx.Int32(UNIT) + tid)
            buffer_ops.buffer_store(_lds_load_raw(rw_mr, tid), sw_rsrc, c * fx.Int32(UNIT) + tid)
        if blk_ok & (nb == c0) & (tid == fx.Int32(UNIT)):
            buffer_ops.buffer_store(ec, se_rsrc, c)
        if (flat == c0) & (tid == fx.Int32(WAVE)):
            buffer_ops.buffer_store(pend, nv_rsrc, c0)
            buffer_ops.buffer_store(fx.Int32(N), nv_rsrc, c1)
        return _raw(pend), _raw(ec), _raw(c0), _raw(etot), _raw(touch), _raw(touch2)

    TPL = -(-N // WAVE)  # tokens per lane of wave 0 in part1w

    @flyc.jit
    def part1w(
        ids_rsrc,
        w_rsrc,
        mask_rsrc,
        out_rsrc,
        sid_rsrc,
        sw_rsrc,
        se_rsrc,
        nv_rsrc,
        x_rsrc,
        lmap_mr,
        cnt_mr,
        rows_mr,
        rw_mr,
        info_mr,
        c_i32,
        nb_i32,
    ):
        """Routing head for pm blocks per workgroup: wave 0 counts the routes per expert in an LDS histogram, lays
        out the blocks with a DPP prefix, and ranks each block's routes in token order by ballot."""
        tid = fx.Int32(arith.index_cast(T.i32, _raw(gpu.thread_idx.x)))
        lane = tid % fx.Int32(WAVE)
        wave = tid // fx.Int32(WAVE)
        c = fx.Int32(c_i32)
        nb = fx.Int32(nb_i32)
        c0 = fx.Int32(0)
        c1 = fx.Int32(1)

        mvals = _mask_lids(mask_rsrc, tid)
        toks = []
        tvalid = []
        gids = []
        wts = []
        for t in range_constexpr(TPL):
            tok = lane + fx.Int32(WAVE * t)
            ok = tok < fx.Int32(N)
            toks.append(tok)
            tvalid.append(ok)
            safe_tok = ok.select(tok, c0)
            g = []
            for j in range_constexpr(topk // 2):
                v = buffer_ops.buffer_load(
                    ids_rsrc, safe_tok * fx.Int32(topk) + fx.Int32(2 * j), vec_width=2, dtype=T.i32
                )
                g.append(fx.Int32(vector.extract(v, static_position=[0], dynamic_position=[])))
                g.append(fx.Int32(vector.extract(v, static_position=[1], dynamic_position=[])))
            gids.append(g)
        for t in range_constexpr(TPL):
            safe_tok = tvalid[t].select(toks[t], c0)
            wv = []
            for j in range_constexpr(topk // 2):
                v = buffer_ops.buffer_load(
                    w_rsrc, safe_tok * fx.Int32(topk) + fx.Int32(2 * j), vec_width=2, dtype=T.i32
                )
                wv.append(fx.Int32(vector.extract(v, static_position=[0], dynamic_position=[])))
                wv.append(fx.Int32(vector.extract(v, static_position=[1], dynamic_position=[])))
            wts.append(wv)

        flat = c * fx.Int32(gx) + nb
        zeros = fx.Vector.filled(4, 0, fx.Int32)
        for i in range_constexpr(z_iters):
            ch = flat + fx.Int32(i * G)
            if ch < fx.Int32(n_chunks):
                buffer_ops.buffer_store(zeros, out_rsrc, ch * fx.Int32(BLOCK * 4) + tid * fx.Int32(4))

        if tid < fx.Int32(UNIT * pm):
            _lds_store_raw(rows_mr, fx.Int32(sentinel), tid)
            _lds_store_raw(rw_mr, c0, tid)
        if tid < fx.Int32(N_LOCAL):
            _lds_store_raw(cnt_mr, c0, tid)

        _lds_store_raw(lmap_mr, _local_id(mvals, tid), tid)
        gpu.barrier()

        if wave == c0:
            les = []
            tmasks = []
            for t in range_constexpr(TPL):
                lt = []
                tm = c0
                for k in range_constexpr(topk):
                    e = _lds_load_raw(lmap_mr, gids[t][k])
                    lt.append(e)
                    tm = tm | (e >= c0).select(c1 << (e & fx.Int32(31)), c0)
                les.append(lt)
                tmasks.append(tvalid[t].select(tm, c0))
            # routes to no local expert add into a dummy word of their own lane, so the adds are branch-free
            cnt_base = fx.Int64(fx.ptrtoint(cnt_mr))
            one = arith.constant(1, type=T.i32)
            for t in range_constexpr(TPL):
                for k in range_constexpr(topk):
                    e = les[t][k]
                    slot_e = ((e >= c0) & tvalid[t]).select(e, fx.Int32(N_LOCAL) + lane)
                    aptr = buffer_ops.create_llvm_ptr(
                        cnt_base + fx.Int64(slot_e) * fx.Int64(4), address_space=3
                    )
                    llvm.AtomicRMWOp(
                        llvm.AtomicBinOp.add,
                        _raw(aptr),
                        one,
                        llvm.AtomicOrdering.monotonic,
                        syncscope="workgroup",
                        alignment=4,
                    )
            total = (lane < fx.Int32(N_LOCAL)).select(_lds_load_raw(cnt_mr, lane & fx.Int32(N_LOCAL - 1)), c0)
            nblk = (total + fx.Int32(UNIT - 1)) // fx.Int32(UNIT)
            blk_incl = _dpp_intra_wave_prefix_sum(nblk, lane, WAVE)
            blk_excl = blk_incl - nblk
            pendw = fx.Int32(rocdl.readlane(T.i32, _raw(blk_incl), _raw(fx.Int32(N_LOCAL - 1)))) * fx.Int32(
                UNIT
            )
            mlo, mhi = _below(lane)
            for m in range_constexpr(pm):
                cmw = c * fx.Int32(pm) + fx.Int32(m)
                inr = (cmw >= blk_excl) & (cmw < blk_incl) & (lane < fx.Int32(N_LOCAL))
                sel = fx.Int32(arith.trunci(T.i32, rocdl.ballot(T.i64, _raw(inr))))
                el = _popc((sel & (c0 - sel)) - c1) & fx.Int32(N_LOCAL - 1)
                ecw = (sel != c0).select(el, fx.Int32(-1))
                sbw = (sel != c0).select(cmw - fx.Int32(rocdl.readlane(T.i32, _raw(blk_excl), _raw(el))), c0)
                etotw = (sel != c0).select(fx.Int32(rocdl.readlane(T.i32, _raw(total), _raw(el))), c0)
                if lane == c0:
                    _lds_store_raw(info_mr, ecw, fx.Int32(4 * m))
                    _lds_store_raw(info_mr, sbw, fx.Int32(4 * m + 1))
                    _lds_store_raw(info_mr, etotw, fx.Int32(4 * m + 2))
                before = c0
                for t in range_constexpr(TPL):
                    slot = c0
                    wsel = c0
                    for k in range_constexpr(topk):
                        mk = les[t][k] == ecw
                        slot = mk.select(fx.Int32(k), slot)
                        wsel = mk.select(wts[t][k], wsel)
                    hit = (((tmasks[t] >> (ecw & fx.Int32(31))) & c1) != c0) & (ecw >= c0)
                    blo, bhi = _ballot(hit)
                    rank = before + _popc(blo & mlo) + _popc(bhi & mhi)
                    if hit & ((rank >> fx.Int32(5)) == sbw):
                        _lds_store_raw(
                            rows_mr,
                            (slot << fx.Int32(24)) | toks[t],
                            (rank & fx.Int32(UNIT - 1)) + fx.Int32(m * UNIT),
                        )
                        _lds_store_raw(rw_mr, wsel, (rank & fx.Int32(UNIT - 1)) + fx.Int32(m * UNIT))
                    if const_expr(t + 1 < TPL):
                        before = before + _popc(blo) + _popc(bhi)
            if lane == c0:
                _lds_store_raw(info_mr, pendw, fx.Int32(3))
        gpu.barrier()
        pend = _lds_load_raw(info_mr, fx.Int32(3))
        res = []
        for m in range_constexpr(pm):
            res.append(
                (
                    _lds_load_raw(info_mr, fx.Int32(4 * m)),
                    _lds_load_raw(info_mr, fx.Int32(4 * m + 1)),
                    _lds_load_raw(info_mr, fx.Int32(4 * m + 2)),
                )
            )

        for m in range_constexpr(pm):
            ec = res[m][0]
            blk_ok = ec >= c0
            cm = c * fx.Int32(pm) + fx.Int32(m)
            if blk_ok & (nb == c0) & (tid < fx.Int32(UNIT)):
                buffer_ops.buffer_store(
                    _lds_load_raw(rows_mr, tid + fx.Int32(m * UNIT)), sid_rsrc, cm * fx.Int32(UNIT) + tid
                )
                buffer_ops.buffer_store(
                    _lds_load_raw(rw_mr, tid + fx.Int32(m * UNIT)), sw_rsrc, cm * fx.Int32(UNIT) + tid
                )
            if blk_ok & (nb == c0) & (tid == fx.Int32(UNIT)):
                buffer_ops.buffer_store(ec, se_rsrc, cm)
        if (flat == c0) & (tid == fx.Int32(WAVE)):
            buffer_ops.buffer_store(pend, nv_rsrc, c0)
            buffer_ops.buffer_store(fx.Int32(N), nv_rsrc, c1)
        out = [_raw(pend)]
        for m in range_constexpr(pm):
            out += [_raw(res[m][0]), _raw(res[m][1]), _raw(res[m][2])]
        if const_expr(pm == 1):
            out += [_raw(c0), _raw(c0)]
        return tuple(out)

    @flyc.jit
    def part2(x_rsrc, a1_rsrc, sc_rsrc, rows_mr, c_i32, ec_i32, sb_i32, etot_i32):
        """Quantize block c's live token rows into a1 and its sorted scales."""
        tid = fx.Int32(arith.index_cast(T.i32, _raw(gpu.thread_idx.x)))
        lane = tid % fx.Int32(WAVE)
        wave = tid // fx.Int32(WAVE)
        c = fx.Int32(c_i32)
        c0 = fx.Int32(0)
        c1 = fx.Int32(1)
        ec = fx.Int32(ec_i32)
        sb = fx.Int32(sb_i32)
        etot = fx.Int32(etot_i32)
        nrows = etot - sb * fx.Int32(UNIT)
        nrows = (nrows > fx.Int32(UNIT)).select(fx.Int32(UNIT), nrows)
        nrows = (ec >= c0).select(nrows, c0)
        for i in range_constexpr(UNIT // NUM_WAVES):
            r = wave + fx.Int32(NUM_WAVES * i)
            if r < nrows:
                tok = _lds_load_raw(rows_mr, r) & fx.Int32(0xFFFFFF)
                p = c * fx.Int32(UNIT) + r
                xbase = tok * fx.Int32(row_words) + lane * fx.Int32(32)
                xv = []
                for j in range_constexpr(8):
                    xv.append(
                        buffer_ops.buffer_load(x_rsrc, xbase + fx.Int32(4 * j), vec_width=4, dtype=T.i32)
                    )
                for g in range_constexpr(2):
                    words = []
                    for j in range_constexpr(4):
                        for q in range_constexpr(4):
                            words.append(
                                fx.Int32(
                                    vector.extract(xv[4 * g + j], static_position=[q], dynamic_position=[])
                                )
                            )
                    vals = []
                    amax = fx.Int32(_AMAX_FLOOR)
                    for wd in range_constexpr(16):
                        lo = words[wd] << fx.Int32(16)
                        hi = words[wd] & fx.Int32(-65536)
                        vals.append(lo)
                        vals.append(hi)
                        alo = lo & fx.Int32(0x7FFFFFFF)
                        ahi = hi & fx.Int32(0x7FFFFFFF)
                        amax = (alo > amax).select(alo, amax)
                        amax = (ahi > amax).select(ahi, amax)
                    qf = arith.bitcast(T.f32, _raw(amax)) * arith.constant(1.0 / 448.0, type=T.f32)
                    qb = fx.Int32(arith.bitcast(T.i32, _raw(qf)))
                    ex = (qb >> fx.Int32(23)) & fx.Int32(0xFF)
                    bump = (ex < fx.Int32(0xFF)) & ((qb & fx.Int32(0x7FFFFF)) != c0)
                    ex = bump.select(ex + c1, ex)
                    inv = arith.bitcast(T.f32, _raw((fx.Int32(254) - ex) << fx.Int32(23)))
                    packed = []
                    for wq in range_constexpr(8):
                        pw = c0
                        for h in range_constexpr(2):
                            fa = arith.bitcast(T.f32, _raw(vals[wq * 4 + 2 * h])) * inv
                            fb = arith.bitcast(T.f32, _raw(vals[wq * 4 + 2 * h + 1])) * inv
                            pw = rocdl.cvt_pk_fp8_f32(T.i32, _raw(fa), _raw(fb), _raw(pw), h)
                        packed.append(_raw(pw))
                    a1off = tok * fx.Int32(model_dim // 4) + lane * fx.Int32(16) + fx.Int32(8 * g)
                    buffer_ops.buffer_store(
                        vector.from_elements(T.vec(4, T.i32), packed[0:4]), a1_rsrc, a1off
                    )
                    buffer_ops.buffer_store(
                        vector.from_elements(T.vec(4, T.i32), packed[4:8]), a1_rsrc, a1off + fx.Int32(4)
                    )
                    y = lane * fx.Int32(2) + fx.Int32(g)
                    ycol = (
                        (y >> fx.Int32(3)) * fx.Int32(256)
                        + (y & fx.Int32(3)) * fx.Int32(64)
                        + ((y >> fx.Int32(2)) & c1) * fx.Int32(2)
                    )
                    off = (
                        (p >> fx.Int32(5)) * fx.Int32(row_scale_bytes)
                        + ycol
                        + (p & fx.Int32(15)) * fx.Int32(4)
                        + ((p >> fx.Int32(4)) & c1)
                    )
                    buffer_ops.buffer_store(arith.trunci(T.i8, _raw(ex)), sc_rsrc, off, offset_is_bytes=True)
        rocdl.sched_barrier(0)

    @flyc.jit
    def part2_wait(sc_rsrc, touch_i32, touch2_i32):
        """Wait for part2's stores but not for W1's first k-tile, requested after them: vector-memory requests
        complete in issue order."""
        rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
        rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=W1_LOADS, lgkmcnt=0, expcnt=0)
        touch = fx.Int32(touch_i32) + fx.Int32(touch2_i32)
        # out of the resource's range, so the store is dropped; it only keeps the x touches alive
        buffer_ops.buffer_store(touch, sc_rsrc, fx.Int32(0x7FFFFFF8), offset_is_bytes=True)
        rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
        gpu.barrier()

    # Inline quantize: thread t holds scale group t mod 8 of k-tile row t / 8, so a wave skips rows that are
    # all padding. The e8m0 bytes go to LDS as two words per row, which iq_scale regathers in the MFMA's scale
    # order.
    def iq_setup(rows_mr, tid_idx, moff=None):
        tid = fx.Int32(arith.index_cast(T.i32, _raw(tid_idx)))
        row = tid >> fx.Int32(3)
        g = tid & fx.Int32(7)
        rrow = row if moff is None else row + fx.Int32(arith.index_cast(T.i32, _raw(moff)))
        tok = _lds_load_raw(rows_mr, rrow) & fx.Int32(0xFFFFFF)
        idx = lambda v: arith.index_cast(T.index, _raw(v))
        return types.SimpleNamespace(
            row=idx(row),
            g8=idx(g * fx.Int32(8)),
            g8b=idx(g * fx.Int32(8) + fx.Int32(4)),
            xoff=tok * fx.Int32(row_words) + g * fx.Int32(16),
            ok=_raw(tok < fx.Int32(N)),
            widx=row * fx.Int32(2) + (g >> fx.Int32(2)),
            pos8=(g & fx.Int32(3)) * fx.Int32(8),
        )

    def iq_load(st, x_rsrc, base_k):
        off = st.xoff + (fx.Int32(arith.index_cast(T.i32, _raw(base_k))) >> fx.Int32(1))
        return [
            buffer_ops.buffer_load(x_rsrc, off + fx.Int32(4 * j), vec_width=4, dtype=T.i32, mask=st.ok)
            for j in range_constexpr(4)
        ]

    def iq_quant(st, xv):
        c0 = fx.Int32(0)
        words = []
        for j in range_constexpr(4):
            for q in range_constexpr(4):
                words.append(fx.Int32(vector.extract(xv[j], static_position=[q], dynamic_position=[])))
        # max |x| of both bf16 halves at once as packed u16 (non-negative floats order as integers)
        v2 = T.vec(2, T.i16)
        m2 = None
        for wd in range_constexpr(16):
            a2 = vector.bitcast(
                v2, vector.from_elements(T.vec(1, T.i32), [_raw(words[wd] & fx.Int32(0x7FFF7FFF))])
            )
            m2 = a2 if m2 is None else _marith.maxui(m2, a2)
        mw = fx.Int32(
            vector.extract(vector.bitcast(T.vec(1, T.i32), m2), static_position=[0], dynamic_position=[])
        )
        mlo = mw << fx.Int32(16)
        mhi = mw & fx.Int32(-65536)
        amax = fx.Int32(_AMAX_FLOOR)
        amax = (mlo > amax).select(mlo, amax)
        amax = (mhi > amax).select(mhi, amax)
        ex = _e8m0(amax)
        packed = []
        for wq in range_constexpr(8):
            pw = vector.bitcast(T.vec(2, T.i16), vector.from_elements(T.vec(1, T.i32), [_raw(c0)]))
            for h in range_constexpr(2):
                src = vector.bitcast(
                    T.vec(2, T.bf16), vector.from_elements(T.vec(1, T.i32), [_raw(words[wq * 2 + h])])
                )
                pw = rocdl.cvt_scalef32_pk_fp8_bf16(
                    T.vec(2, T.i16), pw, src, arith.bitcast(T.f32, _raw(ex << fx.Int32(23))), h == 1
                )
            packed.append(
                vector.extract(vector.bitcast(T.vec(1, T.i32), pw), static_position=[0], dynamic_position=[])
            )
        e1 = fx.Int32(ex.shuffle_xor(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(WAVE)))
        e2 = fx.Int32(ex.shuffle_xor(fx.Int32(2), fx.Int32(WAVE)))
        e3 = fx.Int32(ex.shuffle_xor(fx.Int32(3), fx.Int32(WAVE)))
        p8 = st.pos8
        word = (
            (ex << p8)
            | (e1 << (p8 ^ fx.Int32(8)))
            | (e2 << (p8 ^ fx.Int32(16)))
            | (e3 << (p8 ^ fx.Int32(24)))
        )
        return (
            vector.from_elements(T.vec(4, T.i32), packed[0:4]),
            vector.from_elements(T.vec(4, T.i32), packed[4:8]),
            word,
        )

    def iq_put_scale(asc_mr, buf, st, word):
        _lds_store_raw(asc_mr, word, st.widx + fx.Int32(buf * WAVE))

    def iq_wave_on(tid_idx, etot_i32, sb_i32):
        """Wave-uniform: does this wave's 8-row slice of the block hold a live row?"""
        tid = fx.Int32(arith.index_cast(T.i32, _raw(tid_idx)))
        w = fx.Int32(rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, _raw(tid >> fx.Int32(6))))
        return _raw(w * fx.Int32(8) < fx.Int32(etot_i32) - fx.Int32(sb_i32) * fx.Int32(UNIT))

    def iq_keep(sc_rsrc, touch_i32, touch2_i32):
        buffer_ops.buffer_store(
            fx.Int32(touch_i32) + fx.Int32(touch2_i32), sc_rsrc, fx.Int32(0x7FFFFFF8), offset_is_bytes=True
        )

    def iq_scale(asc_mr, buf, tid_idx):
        tid = fx.Int32(arith.index_cast(T.i32, _raw(tid_idx)))
        # MFMA lane (L, r) wants the bytes of groups L, L + 4 in rows r, r + 16
        lane = tid & fx.Int32(WAVE - 1)
        sh = (lane >> fx.Int32(4)) * fx.Int32(8)
        base = (lane & fx.Int32(15)) * fx.Int32(2) + fx.Int32(buf * WAVE)
        out = fx.Int32(0)
        for i, d in enumerate((0, 2 * 16, 1, 2 * 16 + 1)):
            w = _lds_load_raw(asc_mr, base + fx.Int32(d))
            out = out | (((w >> sh) & fx.Int32(0xFF)) << fx.Int32(8 * i))
        return _raw(out)

    return types.SimpleNamespace(
        alloc=alloc,
        part1=part1s if N <= UNIT else part1w,
        part2=part2,
        part2_wait=part2_wait,
        iq_setup=iq_setup,
        iq_load=iq_load,
        iq_quant=iq_quant,
        iq_put_scale=iq_put_scale,
        iq_keep=iq_keep,
        iq_wave_on=iq_wave_on,
        iq_scale=iq_scale,
    )


@functools.cache
def _make_zero(N, model_dim, gx, gy):
    """Stage-1 zeroing of ``out`` when unfolded: pieces are handed out from the last workgroup backwards, so they
    mostly ride on the m-blocks past num_valid_ids, which exit right after."""
    G = gx * gy
    n_chunks = N * model_dim * 2 // (BLOCK * 16)
    z_iters = (n_chunks + G - 1) // G

    @flyc.jit
    def zero(out_rsrc, c_i32, nb_i32):
        tid = fx.Int32(arith.index_cast(T.i32, _raw(gpu.thread_idx.x)))
        rflat = fx.Int32(G - 1) - (fx.Int32(c_i32) * fx.Int32(gx) + fx.Int32(nb_i32))
        zeros = fx.Vector.filled(4, 0, fx.Int32)
        for i in range_constexpr(z_iters):
            ch = rflat + fx.Int32(i * G)
            if ch < fx.Int32(n_chunks):
                buffer_ops.buffer_store(zeros, out_rsrc, ch * fx.Int32(BLOCK * 4) + tid * fx.Int32(4))

    return zero

            "                _iq_state = [load_x_tile((body_k_base_idx + arith.constant(2 * tile_k, index=True))"
            " % arith.constant(k_dim, index=True))]\n"
            + w1_head
            + "                _fh.iq_keep(ptr_buffer_resource(arg_scale_x, %s), _fold_touch, _fold_touch2)\n"
            % big
        )
    if pm > 1:
        head_call = (
            "            num_valid_i32, _fold_e0, _fold_sb0, _fold_etot0, _fold_e1, _fold_sb1, _fold_etot1 = _fh.part1(\n"
            "                %s, *_fold_lds[:5],\n"
            "                arith.index_cast(T.i32, bx_persist), arith.index_cast(T.i32, by))\n"
            "            _fold_touch = arith.constant(0, type=T.i32)\n"
            "            _fold_touch2 = _fold_touch\n" % r1
        )
        e_edit = (
            "            _fold_m1 = arith.cmpi(CmpIPredicate.ne, mi_p, c0_p)\n"
            "            expert_i32 = arith.select(_fold_m1, _fold_e1, _fold_e0)\n"
            "            _fold_sb = arith.select(_fold_m1, _fold_sb1, _fold_sb0)\n"
            "            _fold_etot = arith.select(_fold_m1, _fold_etot1, _fold_etot0)\n"
            "            _fold_moff = mi_p * arith.constant(%d, index=True)\n" % UNIT
        )
        moff = " + _fold_moff"
    else:
        head_call = (
            "            num_valid_i32, _fold_e, _fold_sb, _fold_etot, _fold_touch, _fold_touch2 = _fh.part1(\n"
            "                %s, *_fold_lds[:5],\n"
            "                arith.index_cast(T.i32, bx_persist), arith.index_cast(T.i32, by))\n" % r1
        )
        e_edit = "            expert_i32 = _fold_e\n            _fold_moff = None\n"
        moff = ""
    return (
        arg_edits
        + scale_edits
        + (
            (
                "            num_valid_i32 = buffer_ops.buffer_load(\n"
                "                numids_rsrc, arith.constant(0, index=True), vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32\n"
                "            )\n",
                "            # fold %s\n"
                "            _fh = _make_fold_head(%d, %d, %d, %d, %d, %s, %d)\n"
                "            _fold_lds = _fh.alloc()\n"
                "            _fold_rows = _fold_lds[2]\n"
                % (fold_digest, N, topk, gx, gy, model_dim, inline_q is None, pm)
                + head_call,
                1,
            ),
            (
                "            expert_i32 = buffer_ops.buffer_load(\n"
                "                expert_rsrc, bx, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32\n"
                "            )\n",
                e_edit,
                1,
            ),
            (
                "                    fused_i = buffer_ops.buffer_load(\n"
                "                        sorted_rsrc, sorted_row_i, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32\n"
                "                    )\n",
                "                    fused_i = _raw(_lds_load_raw(_fold_rows, row_local%s))\n" % moff,
                1,
            ),
            (
                "                    tid_val = buffer_ops.buffer_load(\n"
                "                        sorted_rsrc, tid_row, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32\n"
                "                    )\n",
                "                    tid_val = _raw(_lds_load_raw(_fold_rows, tx%s))\n" % moff,
                1,
            ),
            ("                gate_w0, up_w0 = load_b_tile(k0_b)\n", "", 1),
            (
                "                k0 = body_k_base_idx\n"
                "                if const_expr(use_async_copy):\n"

                part2_head + "                k0 = body_k_base_idx\n"
                "                if const_expr(use_async_copy):\n"
                "                    prefetch_x_to_lds(k0, body_lds_x_pong)\n",

        )
    )


def _edited_builder(fn, edits, name_anchor, tag, extra_ns=None):
    src = inspect.getsource(fn)
    for edit in edits:
        old, new, count = edit if len(edit) == 3 else (*edit, 1)
        assert src.count(old) == count, old
        src = src.replace(old, new)
    # The kernel name carries a digest of the edited source, so a compile cache keyed by name never serves a
    # binary built from other edits.
    tag = tag + "_" + hashlib.sha1(src.encode()).hexdigest()[:10]
    assert src.count(name_anchor) == 1, name_anchor
    src = src.replace(name_anchor, name_anchor[:-1] + tag + name_anchor[-1])
    ns = dict(vars(_mm_common))
    ns.update(extra_ns or {})
    exec(compile(src, _mm_common.__file__, "exec"), ns)
    return ns[fn.__name__]


@functools.cache
def _s1_compile(*, kstag, gate_mode, fold, zero, **kw):
    if fold is None:
        edits = _s1_edits(kstag) + _s1_hoist_edits() + (_S1_PAD_CLAMP,) + _zero_edits(*zero)
        extra_ns = {"_make_zero": _make_zero}
    else:
        edits = _s1_edits(kstag) + _fold_edits(*fold) + (_S1_PAD_CLAMP,)
        extra_ns = {"_make_fold_head": _make_fold_head, "_raw": _raw, "_lds_load_raw": _lds_load_raw}
    builder = _edited_builder(
        _mm_common.compile_mixed_moe_gemm1_common,
        edits,
        '{heterogeneous_tag}_v{kernel_version}"',
        "_kstag%d" % kstag + ("_fold" if fold else "_z") + "_w%d" % kw["waves_per_eu"],
        extra_ns,
    )
    return builder(gate_mode=GateMode(gate_mode), **kw)


@functools.cache
def _s2_compile(*, kstag, nstag, **kw):
    builder = _edited_builder(
        _mm_common.compile_mixed_moe_gemm2_common,
        _s2_edits(kstag, nstag) + _S2_LATE_NUM_VALID,
        '{cumul_tag}{xcd_tag}{acc_tag}"',
        "_kstag%dn%d" % (kstag, nstag),
    )
    return builder(**kw)


@functools.cache
def _plan(n_tokens, topk, global_experts, model_dim):
    """The live m-block bound of one shape, its stage-1 settings, its two GEMM compilers and its prelude (None when
    stage 1 folds the routing in)."""
    live_blocks = min(n_tokens * topk, (n_tokens * topk) // _TILE_M + 31)
    persist_m, s1_stag, s2_stag, s2_ntag, fold, s2_tile_n, s1_wpe, inline_q = next(
        cfg for bound, cfg in _TIERS if n_tokens * topk <= bound
    )
    assert not fold or persist_m == 1 or inline_q is not None  # part2 serves one block per workgroup
    if n_tokens <= _TILE_M:
        # every expert's routes then fit one block
        live_blocks = min(live_blocks, N_LOCAL)
    grid_m = -(-live_blocks // persist_m)
    fold_cfg = (n_tokens, topk, _S1_GX, grid_m, model_dim, inline_q, persist_m) if fold else None
    zero_cfg = None if fold else (n_tokens, model_dim, _S1_GX, grid_m)
    return (
        live_blocks,
        persist_m,
        s2_tile_n,
        s1_wpe,
        inline_q is None,
        functools.partial(_s1_compile, kstag=s1_stag, fold=fold_cfg, zero=zero_cfg),
        functools.partial(_s2_compile, kstag=s2_stag, nstag=s2_ntag),
        None if fold else compile_prelude(n_tokens, topk, global_experts, model_dim, s1_stag),
    )


def _fold_args(extra, *args, **kw):
    """aiter's stage-1 argument tuple with ``extra`` pointers inserted after its own."""
    full = _s1_args_fp4(*args, **kw)
    return full[:11] + extra + full[11:]


def run(
    *,
    hidden_states,
    w1,
    w2,
    topk_weights,
    topk_ids,
    w1_scale,
    w2_scale,
    activation,
    quant_type,
    doweight_stage1,
    gate_mode,
    act_quant,
    expert_mask,
    beta,
    linear_beta,
    swiglu_limit,
    out_dtype,
    out,
):
    device = hidden_states.device
    n_tokens, topk = topk_ids.shape
    global_experts = expert_mask.numel()
    model_dim = hidden_states.shape[1]
    live_blocks, persist_m, s2_tile_n, s1_wpe, async_a, s1_compile, s2_compile, prelude = _plan(
        n_tokens, topk, global_experts, model_dim
    )
    rows = live_blocks * _TILE_M

    live_ids = torch.empty(rows, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    live_weights = torch.empty(rows, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    live_experts = torch.empty(live_blocks, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    num_valid_ids = torch.empty(2, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    a1 = torch.empty((n_tokens, model_dim), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device)
    a1_scale = torch.empty((rows, model_dim // 32), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device)
    if prelude is not None:
        prelude(
            topk_ids,
            topk_weights,
            expert_mask,
            hidden_states,
            live_ids,
            live_weights,
            live_experts,
            num_valid_ids,
            a1,
            a1_scale,
            w1.view(torch.uint8),
            fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream()),
        )
        build_args = functools.partial(_fold_args, (ptr_arg(out),))
    else:
        build_args = functools.partial(
            _fold_args,
            tuple(
                ptr_arg(t) for t in (topk_ids, topk_weights, expert_mask, hidden_states, out, live_weights)
            ),
        )
    a1 = a1.view(dtypes.fp8)
    a1_scale = a1_scale.view(dtypes.fp8_e8m0)
    a2, a2_scale = _flydsl_moe_stage1_impl(
        a=a1,
        w1=w1,
        sorted_token_ids=live_ids,
        sorted_expert_ids=live_experts,
        num_valid_ids=num_valid_ids,
        out=None,
        topk=topk,
        tile_m=_TILE_M,
        tile_n=_S1_TILE_N,
        tile_k=_TILE_K,
        a_dtype="fp8",
        b_dtype="fp4",
        out_dtype="fp8",
        act="silu",
        w1_scale=w1_scale.view(dtypes.fp8_e8m0),
        a1_scale=a1_scale,
        use_async_copy=async_a,
        waves_per_eu=s1_wpe,
        b_nt=2,
        persist_m=persist_m,
        gate_mode="interleave",

        _compile_kernel=s1_compile,
        _build_mx_args=build_args,
    )
    _flydsl_moe_stage2_impl(
        inter_states=a2.view(n_tokens, topk, -1),
        w2=w2,
        sorted_token_ids=live_ids,
        sorted_expert_ids=live_experts,
        num_valid_ids=num_valid_ids,
        out=out,
        topk=topk,
        tile_m=_TILE_M,
        tile_n=s2_tile_n,
        tile_k=_TILE_K,
        a_dtype="fp8",
        b_dtype="fp4",
        out_dtype="bf16",

    )
